title: fix(cli)!: the one-shot secret commands choose the crypto provider from the installed plugins too, by os serve's rule
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `os secret rewrap`, `os secret orphans` and the data migrations' settings arm refuse to run when a plugin `os plugin install` installed is refused and nothing rules out that it provides the crypto provider (`crypto-provider`), and when a config plugin and an installed plugin both declare it, where they ran without reading the installed plugins; widened beside it: the optional `leaveUninstallsPending` on `LoadInstalledPluginsInput` (`@objectstack/runtime`).
Metadata-protocol: none

<!-- adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) no key of any schema is added, removed or re-shaped and no stored row is converted: a one-shot run whose installed plugins hold a refusal that may be the crypto provider stops until the operator fixes that plugin or disables it, which is a choice about one installed plugin made by hand, not a mechanical conversion -->

**BREAKING** for a deployment that runs `os secret rewrap`, `os secret orphans` or a data migration with an installed plugin (`os plugin install`) that `os serve` would refuse to boot with, or with a crypto provider declared both in the host config's `plugins` and by an installed plugin.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：一次性命令(`os secret rewrap`、`os secret orphans`、数据迁移的 settings 部分)选择加密提供者时，现在除了宿主配置的 `plugins`，也读取 `os plugin install` 安装的插件，走 `os serve` 启动时读取它们的同一个加载器，并按 `os serve` 的同一规则判断。
  - 已加载且声明 `crypto-provider` 的已安装插件，就是本次运行加解密所用的插件。
  - 被拒且无法排除是加密提供者的已安装插件，会让本次运行拒绝执行。
  - 两处同时声明加密提供者，也拒绝执行。
  - 本次运行不注册、也不移除任何已安装插件；待完成的卸载留给下次启动。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：改 `@objectstack/cli` 和 `@objectstack/runtime`(均为 patch，声明为 `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`)。
  - 没有安装记录的项目，行为不变。
  - runtime 的 `loadInstalledPlugins` 新增一个可选输入 `leaveUninstallsPending`。
  - 回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/utils/one-shot-settings.ts` 的 `readDeclaredCryptoProvider` 和新的 `readInstalledPlugins`；`packages/cli/src/utils/installed-plugins-boot.ts` 的 `loadHostInstalledPlugins`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/one-shot-crypto-installed-plugins.test.ts`，预期 11/11。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **Before.** A one-shot run (`oneShotCrypto`) chose the crypto provider from the host config's `plugins` only. The installed plugins of the project were not read.
- **Now.** `readDeclaredCryptoProvider` reads the installed plugins beside the config's `plugins`, and judges them by `os serve`'s rule.
  - **The read.** It goes through the new `loadHostInstalledPlugins` (cli `utils/installed-plugins-boot.ts`). That is the loader call `registerInstalledPlugins` already made, split out so `os serve` and the one-shot run read the installed set one way: the trusted keys, the bundle wrap, host package resolution, and a loader failure as one `loader_failed` refusal. `registerInstalledPlugins` now calls it, unchanged otherwise.
  - **An installed plugin that loads and declares `crypto-provider`** is the declaring plugin, composed into the run's boot exactly as a config one is.
  - **A refused installed plugin** goes through `serve`'s `refuseRefusedInstalledCryptoProviderPlugins`: the same rule-outs, the same refusal and the same per-code step.
  - **Two declarations**, config or installed, are refused by `refuseTwoCryptoProviderPlugins`, both named.
  - **A name already taken:** an installed plugin whose name a config plugin, or an installed plugin read before it, takes is refused as `plugin_name_taken`, and one whose name cannot be read as `kernel_refused` (with the thrown reason), as `os serve` refuses them.
  - **A signed installed provider** boots: the wrapper that names the provider when its `init` fails carries the artifact verdict its host recorded for the plugin.
  - **The refusal texts** say an installed provider was installed by `os plugin install`, and a config one that it is declared in the host config.
  - **With no host config**, the installed plugins are still read, as `os serve` reads them.
  - **Nothing is registered or removed.** The run passes `leaveUninstallsPending: true`.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`:** `LoadInstalledPluginsInput.leaveUninstallsPending?`. When it is set, a pending uninstall is neither finished nor loaded, as the next boot that finishes it would not load it either. When it is unset, `os serve`'s boot is unchanged.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Readings on head `9f07d719c` (two commits on `main` at `a61ddc93a`; the second answers review round 1).

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- New `packages/cli/src/utils/one-shot-crypto-installed-plugins.test.ts` (11). It stands in for `loadHostInstalledPlugins`, whose verification is pinned in the runtime suite and end to end in `test/serve-installed-plugins.integration.test.ts`. It boots each composition in a real `ObjectKernel`.
  - With no host config, and again beside a config that declares none, an installed plugin that loads and declares the provider is the one the run seals and opens with. The local key is never resolved, even with `OS_SECRET_KEY` set.
  - Refused, each naming the plugin, its code and the step:
    - a refused installed plugin (`tree_changed`);
    - an imported refused plugin that declares the provider;
    - `loader_failed`.
  - CONTROL: a ruled-out refusal (`runtime_not_dispatched`, or a `kernel_refused` plugin that declares other services), a loaded plugin that declares none, and no installations file each leave the local provider over the existing key.
  - Refused before either initializes: a config plugin and an installed plugin that both declare it, both named.
  - Refused as `plugin_name_taken`: an installed declaring plugin whose name a config plugin takes; and one whose name an installed plugin read before it takes (that first plugin is not named).
  - A signed installed provider, with the verdict recorded on it as the loader records it, boots and seals with its provider.
  - An installed provider that registers none, and one whose `init` throws, are each refused with "as a plugin installed by `os plugin install`" and never "host config".
  - The loader is asked with `{ leaveUninstallsPending: true }`.
- `installed-plugin-loader.test.ts` (runtime, 1 new case): with `leaveUninstallsPending`, a pending uninstall keeps its directory and record and is not loaded, while the next plugin loads. CONTROL: the default read finishes it.
- Red-first with `main`'s blobs:
  - `one-shot-settings.ts`: the new file read 7 failed | 1 passed (8). The control case was the one that passed.
  - `installed-plugin-loader.ts`: the loader file read 1 failed | 65 passed (66).
  - Round 1, `one-shot-settings.ts` at `f89f99cd0`'s blob: the new file read 3 failed | 8 passed (11). The three new cases failed.
- Restored, on this head: 11/11 and 66/66. The five cli files around it (the new file, `one-shot-crypto-provider`, `one-shot-settings.pin`, `installed-plugins-boot`, `serve-host-crypto-provider`) read 74/74. `one-shot-crypto-provider.test.ts` and `installed-plugins-boot.test.ts` are unchanged and green (24/24 across the three cli files).

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/cli` and `packages/runtime`: exit 0 (cli again on this head).
- Under the verify lock, on `f89f99cd0` and before the rebase onto `a61ddc93a`, which touched no file of this diff:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 560 passed (560), Tests 9001 passed | 19 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test` (both tiers, so the one-shot family integration and the `os secret` driver contracts too): Test Files 612 passed | 1 skipped (613), Tests 7591 passed | 9 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Under the verify lock, on `9f07d719c`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test`: Test Files 612 passed | 1 skipped (613), Tests 7593 passed | 9 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed source and test files: exit 0.
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derives 66 families on this diff, the same list on both heads. They ran again on this head after a cli build.
- Every family ran and exited 0. `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

Not measured:
- A one-shot command end to end over a real signed installed provider plugin. The installed set's verification and import are the loader `os serve` uses, which is pinned on its own, and the choice over it, signed stub included, is pinned here with a stand-in loader.
- The runtime package suite on this head: the round-1 delta touches no runtime file.
- A name an installed plugin shares with a plugin `os serve` auto-registers (not one of the host config's). `os serve` refuses it as `plugin_name_taken`, but the one-shot run does not compose those plugins, so it compares against the host config's names and the installed plugins read before it only.
